title: Run the axe pass in CI
goal: The axe pass runs on every PR
acceptance: `.github/workflows/ci.yml` installs the browser and runs the axe pass; a failing violation fails the job
The run is green on `main` and the coverage table names the new test (change impact)
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Fixtures are invented.
validation: npm run check:fast; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: One workflow step plus the browser install and a green run. Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed from the report's effort column. Not a measurement.
